_comment: Example configuration demonstrating all FDR/multiple testing correction methods

_fdr_method_options.description: Choose the multiple testing correction method based on your needs:

fdr_methods.bh: Benjamini-Hochberg (FDR) - Standard choice for most biological data
fdr_methods.storey: Storey's q-value (FDR) - Adaptive, estimates π₀ for potentially higher power
fdr_methods.by: Benjamini-Yekutieli (FDR) - Conservative, works under any dependency structure
fdr_methods.adaptive_bh: Adaptive BH (FDR) - Estimates π₀ and adjusts, often most powerful

fwer_methods.bonferroni: Bonferroni (FWER) - Most conservative, controls family-wise error rate
